outcome: Symptoms of vaginal atrophy (dryness, dyspareunia, itching, burning and paleness)
cohort: 125 postmenopausal women (65 with a history of normal vaginal delivery and 60 with a history of Cesarean section)
finding: Postmenopausal women with a history of normal vaginal delivery were less likely to have GSM compared to women with a history of Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Postmenopausal women with a history of normal vaginal delivery were less likely to have GSM compared to the women with a history of Cesarean section.
